info.title: Welfare Policy Search API
info.description: Search Korean central, local, and Ontong Youth policies using user-provided demographic, regional, employment, household and child information.

post.summary: Search personalized welfare and youth policies
post.description: Search and rank central, local and Ontong Youth policies. Use only conditions the user explicitly provided. Special-target programs are filtered unless the user states a matching condition. Results are counseling candidates, not final eligibility decisions.

age.description: User age in full years. Example: 29

gender.description: Optional gender. Use only when explicitly provided.

sido.description: Province or metropolitan city. Example: 울산광역시

sigungu.description: City, county or district. Example: 북구. Avoid programs limited to another locality.

employmentStatus.description: Employment status such as 미취업, 재직중, 단시간근로, 프리랜서, 일용근로, 자영업, 예비창업

maritalStatus.description: Optional marital status. Do not infer it.

householdType.description: Optional household type for policy matching.

hasChildren.description: Optional child-presence status. Do not infer it.

childrenAges.description: Optional full ages of children. Example: [2, 6].

annualIncome.description: Optional annual income in 10,000 KRW units. Not a final eligibility test.

interest.description: Interest area: 취업·훈련, 주거, 금융, 생계, 의료, 심리·마음건강, 돌봄, 교육·문화, 청년정책

keyword.description: Optional keyword from the user's own words. If the user explicitly states a special status such as 산재, 보훈, 장애, 병역의무, 북한이탈, 다문화, 입양, 가정위탁 or 자립준비, include that concept here. Never invent special-target status.
